reason: The pooled saving against its host is about 25% (SEC 0.333 GJ/t n7 vs cleaning-system 0.442 n5, both DOE bandwidth current-typical vs state-of-the-art). That is past the ~15% bucket line, so the rule (2026-09-24: state of the art goes to the variant matching its saving) puts it in the strong bucket. Check the per-step pairing before renaming.

proposed-label: Conventional distillation train (steam reboilers or fired heaters)
reason: 'fired-heater' misidentifies the archetype: it is the conventional column train, and its pooled energy is mostly reboiler steam (steam 3.675 vs fuel 1.485 GJ/t, n8/n6). Its siblings are distillation-column_heat-integrated and _heat-pumped, so the plain equipment key names the base option. Bare equipment keys are already used (cleaning-system, anaerobic-digester).

proposed-label: Biomass or waste gasification to Fischer-Tropsch liquids
reason: The key reads as generic Fischer-Tropsch, but the archetype is the biomass/waste route; its coal counterpart is gasifier_coal-to-liquids (split on emissions kind). Every other biomass gasifier key names the feed (gasifier_biomass-methanol, -methanation, -ammonia, -ethylene), so this one should too. Coordinator: gasifier_coal-to-liquids (oil-and-gas) could become gasifier_coal-fischer-tropsch for symmetry.

proposed-label: Biomass or waste gasification to Fischer-Tropsch liquids with capture
reason: Follows its host's rename so host and capture variant stay paired. Its description already says biomass, or biomass co-gasified with coal, with the biomass share making it a removal. This is a rename only; the archetype stays (added 2026-10-03 at the modeller's request).

This bucket's host is oven_tunnel-deck, but the key leaves out the host discriminator. Now that oven_electric exists, 'oven_efficiency-moderate' is ambiguous. The label also says 'Bakery', which is a product. Do this with CH03.

'tunnel-deck' is over-specific, left over from merge C07: the archetype now also holds indirect-fired radiant-tube ovens, fryers and roasters, and its label already says 'Gas-fired oven'. 'fuel-fired' is an existing discriminator (boiler_fuel-fired) and pairs with oven_electric.
new-vocabulary: none (fuel-fired exists; widen its definition to ovens)

proposed-label: Natural-gas reforming and methanol synthesis (whole plant)
reason: 'syngas' doesn't identify the route: the coal, biomass and CO2 methanol routes all go through syngas too. The archetype is the whole natural-gas plant (natural gas 36.5 GJ/t, n2; examples include steam-reformer_methanol from IPCC and gasifier_natural-gas). It is the methanol counterpart of steam-reformer_ammonia, so it should use the same equipment_product pattern.

Pairs with gasifier_biomass-fischer-tropsch if that rename is taken: the two keys then differ only in feed, which is the emissions-kind difference that splits them (chemicals reviewer, cross-family note).

Every other CHP archetype uses the chp discriminator (reciprocating-engine_chp, fuel-cell_chp, anaerobic-digester_chp, gasifier_biomass-chp). The heat-recovery steam generator is a part, and since combined-cycle CHP was merged in (2026-09-30) the key no longer describes the whole group.

The label ('Generating set efficiency measures') does not match the key. Its only example is UKERC 'combined-cycle_efficiency-moderate', a measure on a combined-cycle plant. Its estimated capex of 126 CAD/GJ-yr, built from the simple-cycle host, is above combined-cycle itself (53), and the SEC of 0.548 is D05. The alternative is to remap the UKERC row and leave the simple-cycle bucket as a gap.
Uses the same term as fan_optimization and pump_optimization for the same idea: system-level measures (leaks, pressure, sequencing, right-sizing) on a motor-driven service.

proposed-label: Fuel-fired direct heater efficiency measures, moderate
reason: The key leaves out its host. It sits beside direct-heater_solid-fuel_efficiency-strong, whose host is named, and every other bucket names its host (boiler_fuel-fired_efficiency-moderate). The label says 'fired heater or boiler plant', but the boiler measures belong on boiler_fuel-fired_efficiency-moderate.

proposed-label: Fuel-fired direct heater efficiency measures, strong
reason: Same reason as the moderate bucket. Bataille's electricity, hydrogen, biogas and LPG efficiency-strong rows are also mapped here, outside the carrier list; check them before renaming.

proposed-label: Electric process heater (resistance, induction or RF)
reason: Matches boiler_electric. Since the merges of resistance, induction and RF heating (C04, C05), 'electric' is the only distinction left, and 'process' is redundant.

Uses the same term as boiler_fuel-fired and space-heater_fuel-fired for the same distinction. '-process' adds nothing because a direct heater is already a process heater. Rename it together with direct-heater_electric-process so the pair still matches.

The closed equipment list has rotary-compression-heater, defined as 'a rotating machine heating a gas by compression', and the extractions already use that name. 'RotoDynamic' is Coolbrook's product name, which keys must not carry. This rename is moot if XC08 merges the archetype into the electric heater.

geothermal-well_direct-use was merged in on 2026-09-30, so the archetype now covers both natural-aquifer direct use and enhanced (stimulated) systems, and 'enhanced' is a merge leftover. In geothermal terms 'direct use' means heat rather than power, which is the right contrast with _binary-power and _flash-power. The term is already in the vocabulary.
'fleet' adds nothing. The diesel discriminator is already used for mobile-equipment_diesel and drilling-rig_diesel, and the other haul-truck keys name only the drive. Low priority.

LNG is a carrier and does not belong in a key. dual-fuel is an existing term (reciprocating-engine_dual-fuel) and names the equipment change: a diesel engine converted to run on gas with a diesel pilot.
The discriminator repeats the equipment definition ('a winder raising ore ... in a mine shaft'), and there is only one hoist archetype.

'forklift' is a product type and 'gas' a carrier. The equipment difference from mobile-equipment_diesel is the spark-ignition engine. The existing gasoline-propane term is a fallback, but it leaves out natural gas.
new-vocabulary: spark-ignition (discriminator): spark-ignited engine on propane, natural gas or gasoline

reason: Cooler heat recovery is an incremental measure on one device (pellet-plant_induration). §2 puts such measures in its efficiency bucket and names the measure in examples-named. It has no examples, so check moderate against strong once data arrive.

proposed-label: Small nuclear reactor (SMR, high-temperature or micro)
reason: After C35 the archetype covers SMR, HTGR, nuclear steam supply and microreactors. 'small-modular' is a size class and also over-specific for the group.
new-vocabulary: nuclear (discriminator): a nuclear reactor supplying heat, steam or power at an industrial site

reason: 'high-temperature' is a temperature tier, which §3 bans from keys. Trough and Fresnel concentrators are already in solar-collector, so the bare equipment term identifies tower and dish.

proposed-label: By-product coke oven efficiency measures, moderate
reason: The host is the by-product battery, not the heat-recovery oven (coke-oven_heat-recovery has no buckets). Other bucketed hosts carry their discriminator in the bucket key (furnace_reheating_efficiency-*, rolling-mill_hot_efficiency-moderate).

proposed-label: By-product coke oven efficiency measures, strong
reason: Same as coke-oven_efficiency-moderate: dry quenching and raw-gas heat recovery are measures on the by-product battery.

The digester has no flue gas. The CO2 sent to capture comes from the calciner (and from the boilers, which already have boiler_ccs-diffuse). Under design s2 the host-with-capture should name its host; the one example (IEA 'CO2 capture in the Bayer process') has no numbers, so a rename costs little. The node stays the alumina leaf.

proposed-label: Electric arc furnace with scrap preheating
reason: 'high-efficiency' does not name a technology and overlaps the efficiency-* modifiers. About 30 of the 38 examples are scrap-preheating or continuous-charging designs: Consteel, finger and Fuchs shaft, EcoArc, twin-shell, Quantum, Contiarc, IHI. The handful of generic UKERC 'efficiency-moderate' and 'furnace' rows and the plain DC-furnace row should be checked when renaming.
new-vocabulary: discriminator scrap-preheating: 'EAF that preheats the scrap charge with its off-gas (shaft, conveyor or twin shell), often with continuous charging'

reason: A process name in the key, and too narrow: the description covers both Pidgeon and Magnetherm. 'silicothermic' alone identifies the route against electrolysis-cell_magnesium-chloride.
new-vocabulary: discriminator silicothermic: 'Reduction of calcined dolomite or magnesia with ferrosilicon'; retire silicothermic-pidgeon

reason: The equipment definition already says a sinter plant is a strand, so 'strand' distinguishes nothing; the plant's own buckets are already named sinter-plant_efficiency-moderate/-strong without it, so the base key is the odd one out.

Discriminator left over from a merge: since C24 (2026-10-02) the archetype also holds single-vessel bath smelting (HIsarna), so 'two-stage' is wrong for part of what it covers. The label's '(two-stage or bath)' becomes unnecessary once the key is general.
new-vocabulary: discriminator smelting-reduction: 'Coal-based reduction of iron ore to hot metal without coke ovens, in a melter-gasifier with pre-reduction shaft or in a single bath vessel'; retire two-stage and bath-reduction

reason: Rename it together with its host (C24 merged the base and capture archetypes as a pair).

equipment electrolyzer is defined as water splitting to hydrogen; electrolysis-cell covers separating a product electrochemically. NOTE for coordinator: decisions.md 2026-09-26 dropped electrolysis-cell_limestone-decarbonation; it came back on 2026-10-02 under electrolyzer_ at TRL 3, below the TRL 5-6 scope rule. Confirm it should exist before renaming.
'gas' is a carrier in the key (§3); the gas-fired base is already implied by 'assisted'. Label made to name the ceramic kiln.

Examples are measures on the lime-mud kiln (product cooler, chain section, external mud dryer, DOE BAT kiln), i.e. incremental measures on one device: design §2 buckets them. Pooled fuel 5.8 GJ/t (n2) vs host 8.1 (n6), about 29% saving, so the strong bucket.

Every other glass-melting archetype is furnace_glass-*; this one alone uses melting-furnace and repeats 'melt' in the discriminator. Aligns the glass furnace node. (equipment.csv defines both furnace and melting-furnace as covering glass melting; one definition should drop glass.)
decision: confirm; furnace should drop glass | applied 2026-10-05

reason: Over-specific: Fourdrinier and gap formers together are the whole conventional class, and it is the only conventional paper machine. Equipment-only keys are allowed (solar-collector, cleaning-system).
Follows the host rename.
Follows the host rename; label also made parallel to the moderate bucket (currently 'press section ... strong' vs 'Paper machine ... moderate').
process-improvement is defined as 'not a device'; a drum debarker and disc chipper is a device. No existing equipment term fits.
new-vocabulary: equipment debarker (A drum or ring machine stripping bark from logs, with its chipper); discriminator drum

reason: Left over from a merge. Membrane capture was folded in on 2026-10-01, and 4 of its 5 examples are membranes or membrane-assisted liquefaction (Plaza, Kearns, Voldsund, Gardarsdottir). The label 'Cryogenic post-combustion capture' misdescribes most of them. What the group has in common is all-electric capture on a dilute stream.
new-vocabulary: discriminator 'membrane-cryogenic': all-electric membrane or low-temperature separation of CO2 from flue gas

reason: Its only example is a whole LNG train (Zhang 2020 DMR) and it serves the lng-liquefaction node beside the other liquefaction-train archetypes; 'chiller' and 'refrigeration' do not identify an LNG plant. Electric drive is the distinction (grid power instead of on-site turbine combustion), so the existing 'electric' discriminator fits, as on fracturing-fleet_electric and steam-cracker_electric. Goes with OG01/OG02.

proposed-label: Low-emission compressor seals and rod packing
reason: Left over from a merge: 4 of its 13 examples are low-bleed rod packing on reciprocating compressors, not dry gas seals, and the label already lists both. A general discriminator covers the group, and with OG10 it would also cover wet-seal degassing recovery.
new-vocabulary: discriminator 'low-emission-seal': seal or packing upgrades (dry gas seals, low-bleed rod packing, seal-gas recovery) that cut compressor seal venting

reason: An efficient variant of compressor_gas-engine-drive (newer engine and compressor, lower fuel use). The turbine node names its counterpart combustion-turbine_drive_efficiency-moderate. Bucket naming makes the host clear. It has 0 examples, so renaming costs nothing.

Label leaves out hydrogen, and 4 of its 9 examples are the pipe itself (pipeline_hydrogen-transmission from ANL HDSAM and DOE 2024). The 'pipeline' equipment covers a pipeline with its compression, and this makes it the same pattern as pipeline_co2. Reuses the existing 'hydrogen' discriminator (already on liquefaction-train_hydrogen and storage-cavern_hydrogen).
new-vocabulary: discriminator 'hydrogen': broaden the definition from 'Hydrogen liquefaction and road transport' to 'Carries, stores or handles hydrogen'

proposed-label: Non-emitting controllers and pumps (instrument air or electric)
reason: Its examples are not compressors. They are non-emitting pneumatic instruments and electric chemical-injection pumps (ECCC 2025) as well as instrument-air conversions. The archetype competes on venting.controls with pneumatic-device_gas-driven and pneumatic-device_low-bleed, so one equipment term would make the three options read as a set: gas-driven, low-bleed, non-emitting. This costs 43 example re-keys, so the modeller may judge it not worth it.
new-vocabulary: discriminator 'non-emitting': controllers and pumps driven by compressed air or electricity, venting no natural gas

reason: On the same supply.drilling node, fracturing-fleet_electric uses 'electric' for the same idea (grid or site power instead of diesel). Two discriminators for one concept. 'electric' already exists, and this archetype has 0 examples.

proposed-label: Amine sweetening with capture of the separated CO2
reason: Every other host-with-capture is named host + modifier (steam-reformer_methane_ccs-concentrated, reactor_integrated-upgrader_ccs-concentrated, gasifier_coal-methanol_ccs-concentrated). Without the host discriminator the key does not say which gas-treatment unit it is (the family also has glycol dehydration, sulphur recovery and acid-gas-advanced). Its host is the amine sweetener.

proposed-label: Coal or petroleum-coke gasification to hydrogen with capture
reason: Same host+modifier rule. Since 2026-10-02 there are several gasifier hosts with capture (coal-methanol, fischer-tropsch), so a bare 'gasifier_ccs-concentrated' is ambiguous. The host was set to gasifier_coal-petroleum-coke on 2026-10-02. Check: the Carbo 2011 BioSNG-with-CCS example (methanation) and the IPCC biomass-with-CCS example don't fit a hydrogen-from-coal host and may need re-homing (biomass methanation has no capture variant).

It is a set of incremental measures on the crude unit (pinch-designed preheat train, fouling control). Under design §2 that is the host's efficiency bucket, not a separate heat-recovery device. Same-source (Barthe 2015) heat 0.36 vs 0.62 GJ/t on the host (-42%) and fuel 0.435 vs 0.624 (-30%), so it belongs in 'strong'. The current key names neither the host nor that it is a bucket.

proposed-label: Steam methane reformer efficiency measures, moderate
reason: An efficiency bucket should name its host. 'steam-reformer' alone has two hosts (steam-reformer_methane in GJ H2, steam-reformer_ammonia in t NH3), which is why its product unit is t while it serves the GJ hydrogen node (open data-check D08). The hydrogen examples (UKERC 'Steam reformer (Hydrogen)') stay under this name. The ammonia examples move to steam-reformer_ammonia_efficiency-moderate (see OG07).
new-vocabulary: new archetype steam-reformer_ammonia_efficiency-moderate (all vocabulary terms already exist)

reason: The label doesn't say this is a chlor-alkali cell, while its three siblings (membrane, diaphragm, mercury) all carry 'chlor-alkali' in the key. Fixing the label is cheaper than renaming the key.
The current label 'Nitric acid oxidation adipic acid plant' reads as though nitric acid is being oxidized. Putting the product first makes it clear.

proposed-label: Ammonium nitrate and calcium ammonium nitrate plant
reason: 'CAN' is jargon; spell it out.
Same product-first form as the adipic acid label, so the two N2O-emitting plants read alike.

proposed-label: Biomass fast pyrolysis with oil upgrading
reason: 'Pyrolysis oil upgrading' covers only the second half of the route. The description and examples are whole plants (fast pyrolysis of biomass, then hydroprocessing). Naming the feed also separates it from reactor_plastics-pyrolysis.

The label ('Fixed-flow ventilation with direct-fired air heater') also covers the main fans, which fan_mine-ventilation already supplies on the same node, so fan energy would be counted twice. The key names only the heater. This rename is moot if XC12 merges it.

Keep the key: back-pressure is the operating principle and pairs with _condensing. The label should say CHP, as the other CHP labels do, because the archetype is boiler plus turbine supplying process steam.
Since membrane separation was merged in (C22, 2026-10-02) the label 'Cryogenic' is too narrow; the equipment definition already says 'cryogenically or by membrane'.

proposed-label: Bell annealing in a hydrogen atmosphere
reason: 'Hydrogen bell annealing' reads as a hydrogen-fired furnace. The hydrogen is the protective gas (100% H2 in place of HNx), and the carriers stay natural gas or electricity.
'on fossil steam' is no longer true: since C15 merged the electric, hydrogen and biomass variants, carriers list electricity, hydrogen and biomass.

Hydrogen firing changes only the burner, so it belongs as a carrier on furnace_anode-baking (as in C15 and C17). Only electric baking changes the equipment. Move hydrogen to the base carriers. No examples are affected (n=0).

Matches the label of its host ('Shaft-furnace direct reduction') and the pattern of the other capture labels ('Blast furnace with post-combustion capture', 'Coal-based smelting reduction with capture'). Which stream is captured belongs in the description, which already says it.
Takes the brand name (Tecnored) out of the label; the brand is already in examples-named.
Brand name (Sublime) in label; the brand is already in examples-named.

Examples are conventional batch kraft (Jacobs 'batch-kraft_conventional', NRCan mill survey), not displacement batch; pooled steam 4.45 GJ/ADt is more than double the continuous digester, so 'with displacement heating' (and type 'efficient variant') misdescribes it. Type should probably read conventional.
Label says 'and sulphite' but all 3 examples are semi-chemical (Jacobs 2006, Kramer 2009); sulphite has its own archetype digester_sulphite, so the label overlaps a sibling.
Only one of 8 examples is a heat pump (MIDDEN tc0324); heat-pump drying is its own archetype (dryer_heat-pump) at about a third of the energy. Relabel once that example moves (see combine MN04).
Brand name (Brimstone) in label; the brand is already in examples-named.

'Rotary lime kiln' reads as the same technology as kiln_lime-rotary-preheater ('Rotary lime kiln with preheater'); this one is the kraft-mill lime-mud reburning kiln on the chemical-recovery node (8.1 GJ/t vs 5.4 for limestone).

All 15 examples are coke cupolas (cold-blast, hot-blast, with oxygas burners; ARIES 2024); 'or gas-fired melting furnace' suggests a gas furnace that is not there and overlaps melting-furnace_rotary-oxy-fuel and _crucible-gas-fired.

Description and all 5 examples are dry sheet forming (one foam); 'Paper making without water' overstates foam forming. Related open item: UK TIMES dry sheet forming currently sets the paper-machine_fourdrinier-gap central and belongs here.
Only if the oxygen links are split off (OG08). The label doesn't say what the beds separate, and the archetype currently serves both ccs.concentrated and two oxygen-supply nodes.
The label 'Dehydration and compression' doesn't name the gas, and it sits on the same ccs node as other units that also dry and compress gas. The key is fine.

Only if OG13 is not adopted: the label 'Electric-drive compression' does not match the key and reads almost the same as its sibling 'Electric-drive compressor' (compressor_electric-drive-centrifugal). If OG13 is adopted, both become compressor_electric.

proposed-label: Biomass or waste gasification to hydrogen
reason: As above. The biofuels and chemicals families have gasifier_biomass-methanol, -methanation, -ammonia and -ethylene, so the hydrogen product should be named. Key unchanged.

proposed-label: Coal or petroleum-coke gasification to hydrogen
reason: There are now five other coal or biomass gasifiers (to SNG, methanol, ammonia, liquids, Fischer-Tropsch), so the label should say this is the hydrogen route. Not proposing a key change, to keep renaming down.

The current label 'Thickened, paste or dry-stack tailings' overlaps separator_tailings-reclaim ('Tailings thickening and water reclaim', mining), which sits on the same two tailings-disposal nodes. Its one example is filtered tailings (KCB 2017). Dropping 'thickened' leaves conventional thickening to tailings-reclaim. Key unchanged.
